Validate your ticket where required. Inspectors can issue fines on the spot.
Download offline maps of the city before you arrive, in case mobile data is slow.
Check for strikes and engineering works the day before you travel.
Keep bags closed and in front of you on crowded metros and trams, where pickpockets work.
Check the last metro or train time before a night out. A night bus or taxi may be your only option.
Contactless cards and phone payment work on many networks, but confirm the city's rules first.
